mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that dampens corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a decline in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) signals a successful monetary tightening that stabilizes the economy without causing a recession, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp and CPIAUCSL falls > 0.1 index points in prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.25pp and CPIAUCSL falls by at least 0.1 index points in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% indicates a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), strong monthly payroll growth (PAYEMS > 200k) signals robust consumer spending and corporate earnings momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts (HOUST) below 1.2 million units signals weak residential construction and declining consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1200.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakness in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls > 10 and RSAFS falls > 500 in prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST falls by at least 10 thousand units and RSAFS falls by at least 500 million dollars in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) of at least 0.5 index points signals expanding manufacturing and services output, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5 index points from the prior month.
